{{Youmay|the personal mining exo-frame|the [[Mining rig/Legends|200-meter mining platform]]}}
A '''mining rig''' was a personal exo-frame worn by [[Miner/Legends|miners]]. Each rig included a number of tools, including lights, [[ore sensor]]s, [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], three different [[Laserdrill/Legends|laser drills]], a [[Camera/Legends|camera]], attachments for a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]], and a short range [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]].
